recent_posts: Uganda's shilling held at 3,712 to the dollar, little changed over the past week and confined to a 2.2% band over the past month. It is down 2.5% for the year and 4.1% weaker than 3,557 a year ago. #Uganda $UGX

Against the dollar the lira fell to 47.9, reaching its weakest level since tracking began in 2024. The rate, which was 43.0 at the start of the year, has lost 5.2% over the past 90 days. #Turkiye $TRY

The Tunisian dinar stands at 2.921 to the dollar, after fluctuating within a 1.7% band over the past month. Notably, the five independent sources used in setting the fix disagreed by 1.26%, well above the usual 0.29%. #Tunisia $TND

The Peruvian sol trades at 3.373 per dollar, its strongest level in 124 days. The currency is up 1.9% over the past 90 days, while the country's economy showed a slowdown in June due to a drop in fishing and agriculture.
